question:
Select the word from among the given options that is closest in meaning to the underlined word in the given sentence.

Ajay was __cautious__ when investing in the stock market.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Careful)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Cautious"** refers to being careful to avoid potential dangers or problems. (सावधान)

 
 
• **Example:** He was cautious while crossing the busy street to ensure his safety.
 
 
 
• **"Careful"** means giving attention and thought to avoid harm or mistakes. (सावधान)
 
 
• **Example:** She was careful to lock all the doors before leaving the house.
 
 
 
• Since "cautious" and "careful" have very similar meanings, they are closest in meaning in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Careful)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lax** (ढीला): Not strict or severe; careless or negligent.

 
 
• **Example:** The company faced problems because of lax security measures.
 
 
 
• **Heedless** (लापरवाह): Showing a reckless lack of care or attention.
 
 
• **Example:** His heedless driving caused several accidents on the road.
 
 
 
• **Elaborate** (विस्तृत): Involving many carefully arranged parts or details; detailed and complicated.
 
 
• **Example:** The designer created an elaborate plan for the new building.
